Thank you for downloading Auto Center!


INSTALLATION:
You have two ways to install:

1. Easy install (recommended)
   Right-click AutoCenter_Installer.bat and choose "Run as administrator".
   It will:
     - Trust the Auto Center signing certificate (one-time, system-wide)
     - Install the .msixbundle package
     - Launch the app

   You only need to trust the certificate once — future updates from this
   same channel reuse it.

2. Manual install
   a. Open SystemFiles\AutoCenter_*.cer, click "Install Certificate...",
      choose "Local Machine", and place it in "Trusted Root Certification
      Authorities".
   b. Double-click SystemFiles\AutoCenter_*.msixbundle and press "Install"
      in the App Installer dialog.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Note: GitHub releases provide the full feature set without restrictions. The only trade-off is
that updates must be installed manually. If you prefer automatic background updates, consider
the Microsoft Store version (https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NJBD74TXX5B?mode=direct).

The Microsoft Store version is a small one-time purchase that supports ongoing development.
